As Banco Santander Chile New (BSAC) Stock Rose, Harding Loevner LP Has Upped Stake; As Eli Lil (LLY) Share Value Declined, Shareholder Vantage Investment Partners Cut Stake 
April 20, 2018 - By Clifton Ray 
Harding Loevner Lp increased its stake in Banco Santander Chile New (BSAC) by 0.35% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Harding Loevner Lp bought 21,750 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.47% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 6.32 million shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $197.59 million, up from 6.30 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Harding Loevner Lp who had been investing in Banco Santander Chile New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $15.38 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.24% or $0.08   $33.94. About 141,750 shares traded. Banco Santander-Chile (NYSE:BSAC) has risen 31.30%   outperformed by 19.75% the S&P500.
